## Roles of the cases corrected (12 November 2026)

- The curator's statement of 12 November 2026: DCAT-AP-JRC and StatDCAT-AP are the development cases; mobilityDCAT-AP, GeoDCAT-AP and HealthDCAT-AP are the test cases. Looking at HealthDCAT-AP outputs before the workflow was frozen was allowed under a restriction (no reference content into the workflow, nothing implemented for the case), so that it does not become a development case. Earlier wording in this folder overstated that decision.
- Record, roles, what the files show about each case, and limits: [case-roles/README.md](case-roles/README.md); record: `case-roles/statement-2026-11-12.json`.

- Not changed: every row, atom, label, count and ID; the historical files; trace steps M12 and M13, which record the marks of 7 November as they were made; the backfill, whose open gap G-061 this record answers.

limits: One person's statement about his own decisions; no second source.
